messages:
mara: Quick sync — Aurora on-prem Dedicated rollout. Proposing Wed Mar 25 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu Mar 26 15:00-15:30 PT. Need infra, network, security, SRE, and customer eng on the call.
Agenda (proposed): 1) Preflight checklist, 2) VPC peering & routes, 3) Secrets/KMS/HSM, 4) Canary plan + rollback, 5) Next steps.
Who can make which slot? Please reply with slot or +1 for both.

dennis: I prefer Wed 10:00 PT. I can own canary steps & rollback doc. I'll post the canary run steps later today.

lee: Thu afternoon better for me. If we do Wed, can we make it 30m or extend to 45m? :thinking_face:

kai: I can do either but prefer Wed. Runbook is ~80% done — PRing the network snippets now:
```
# minimal terraform snippet for VPC peering (in repo PR)
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "aurora_customer" {
  peer_vpc_id = var.customer_vpc_id
  vpc_id      = aws_vpc.aurora.id
  auto_accept = true
}
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood/aurora-onprem/pull/42 — includes terraform + docs.

soumi: Heads up: customer requires HSM-backed keys and IP allowlist. Need security sign-off. @sre-jen can you confirm HSM availability in their region?

sre-jen: Can confirm HSM in us-west-2. Not available in ap-south-1. Which region is Aurora targeting? :mag:

mara: Aurora target region is us-west-2. HSM available. @deploy-bot can you create a poll? If not I'll lock Wed 10:00 if more +1s by EOD.

deploy-bot: Poll created: https://polls.company/aurora-rollout — options: Wed 10, Thu 15 — votes so far: Wed(2), Thu(1)

dennis: :thumbsup: locking Wed 10 if nobody objects by EOD today.

lee: If we lock Wed, I may join remote for first 20m then drop. Will review PR beforehand.

mara: Agenda updated and calendar invite draft here: https://calendar/invite?event=aurora-rollout — will include dial-in + runbook link. Pre-reads: PR above and internal preflight checklist: https://redwood.corp/runbooks/aurora-preflight

ops-bot: Preflight checklist status: network:true, firewall:false, image-bake:true, monitoring:false. Assign owners? ping @ops-team

kai: Assigning owners: network->me, image-bake->dennis, monitoring->lee, firewall->sre-jen

sre-jen: Firewall rules require CIDR from the customer's infra team. @mara can you confirm and paste CIDR?

mara: Asked customer for CIDR, ETA EOD. I'll paste here when they reply.

dennis: I'll draft the canary rollback snippet and paste in thread once PR merged. Quick question for design: blue/green or canary? I prefer canary for smaller footprint.

lee: Canary + traffic shadowing for the first hour then scale. We'll need rate-limit smoke tests.

mara: OK locking Wed 10:00 PT. Calendar invite sent. Please add any items you want covered in the first 10m. Thanks everyone :tada:

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created and sent to the distribution list. Event: 'Aurora Dedicated Rollout - Readiness Sync' Wed Mar 25 10:00 PT, duration 30m.
